title: Perfect for why I needed it
text: Perfect for why I needed it. I needed something to put on the back of my toilet to hold feminine items and a spare roll of toilet paper.  This is perfect!  It's cute and I love the fact, it has a cover.

product_metadata.title: Household Essentials ML-7194 White Paper Rope
features: White paper rope toilet paper roll holder for large rolls
Tightly hand-woven White paper rope for strength and softness
Store extra toilet tissue out of sight but in close reach
Painted steel and White paper rope
description: Store extra toilet paper in this White paper rope wicker toilet roll paper! oversized to fit rolls up to 7 inch diameter. Tightly woven paper rope weave is supple and soft, so paper stays intact. Lift off lid for easy fill, and to keep rolls out of sight.
